target: This is sufficient... / quantifiable antecedent / theme trap
skill: 后句This+数量必须有可计量先行内容，不能只凭problem→solution
q: The hospital board says the size of its training budget may not be the main problem. [BLANK] This is a sufficient number of hours if sessions address the most frequent errors. Which sentence best fills the blank?
o: The board urged instructors to reconsider the goals of clinical education.
Staff nurses receive six hours of simulation training each month.
The department combined several medical units into one joint task force.
Several written assessments have become more demanding this year.

exp.trans: 医院管理层认为培训预算规模可能并非主要问题。空后说：如果培训针对最常见的错误，这个小时数就是足够的。应填入护士每月接受六小时模拟训练的信息。
exp.structure: 后句This is a sufficient number of hours的This需要一个明确时长先行内容。B项six hours满足，前文budget提供主题背景，但不能只靠前文的problem寻找任何泛泛的solution。
exp.other: training budget 培训预算；simulation training 模拟训练；sufficient 足够的；reconsider 重新考虑。
exp.meaning: 原文前后双向核验：problem→solution是泛语义关联，不如This+具体数量的指代关系有约束力。正确项中的six hours与后句number of hours精确衔接。
exp.rest: 改变教育目标、合并科室、增加书面考核均未说明小时数，填入后会导致This缺少合适先行内容。

target: This proportion / measurable percentage / unrelated topic
skill: 比例指代需要数量基线，避免凭本段主题选句
q: The city wants to assess whether the space reserved for public gardens is sufficient. [BLANK] This proportion would be enough if new plots were placed near crowded neighborhoods. Which sentence fits best?
o: The city also plans to make gardeners more aware of soil safety.
Researchers expect volunteers to help with seasonal maintenance tasks and outreach.
Recent records show that one tenth of vacant lots are reserved for gardens.
Several gardens have attracted growing interest from local schools.

exp.trans: 城市想判断公共花园预留空间是否够用。空后说如果地块靠近人口密集社区，这个比例就足够。应填入‘有十分之一的空置地块预留给花园’的统计数据。
exp.structure: This proportion的先行内容必须是可作为比例的数据。C项one tenth of vacant lots提供比例；其余选项只是相关话题，没有提供所指比例。
exp.other: proportion 比例；vacant lot 空置地块；outreach 外展活动；plot 小块土地。
exp.meaning: 即使四句都围绕社区花园，只有能解释This proportion的句子才构成强衔接。不能将同一话题等同于相邻句必然连贯。
exp.rest: 土壤安全、志愿者维护、学校兴趣都与花园相关，但无法为This proportion提供数值。

target: new funding mechanism / That consequence / topical two-group distractor
skill: 制度改革先说明执行机制，再由That引出合作结果
q: A public library will stop funding children's and adult literacy programs through entirely separate budgets. Officials stress that the reform should strengthen both. [BLANK] That should produce more projects serving whole families, rather than two unrelated groups. Which fits?
o: The new process will require both programs to design projects together.
Regional libraries have published more reports about literacy this year.
Some employees focus on adult readers, while others teach children.
The board will create separate committees for each age group.

exp.trans: 图书馆计划取消儿童和成人识字项目完全分立的预算。改革目标是同时加强两者。随后要解释两项目如何一起设计方案，这才能使服务整个家庭的合作项目增加。
exp.structure: That回指空格中描述的具体做法；new process...design projects together才会自然导致projects serving whole families。两个研究群体的存在是话题背景，不是合作机制。
exp.other: literacy 读写能力；entirely separate 完全分开的；joint project 联合项目；committee 委员会。
exp.meaning: topic match≠discourse link：后句That should produce...是结果句，前句需要明确的行动或机制。如果只描述两个群体，读起来相关却没有形成因果链。
exp.rest: 发表报告不一定促进合作；成人/儿童分工只描述现状；继续成立独立委员会甚至背离整合改革的目标。

target: policy integration / mechanism / This change consequence
skill: 空前改革目标与空后合作效果需要中间实施步骤
q: A museum plans to replace isolated conservation and education grants with a shared application process. Its directors say neither department will lose support. [BLANK] This change could generate exhibitions linking research and visitor experience. Which fits?
o: The museum has recently seen a sharp increase in visitor attendance.
Staff will evaluate proposals jointly and choose teams to collaborate.
The departments have long published very different research reports.
The museum will divide each grant into two fixed independent parts.

exp.trans: 博物馆将把保护和教育研究的独立资助改成联合申请。管理层说两部门都不会失去支持。空格要解释联合评审并选择合作团队，才能顺接‘这一变化会产生连接研究与观众体验的展览’。
exp.structure: 空格前提供改革背景和意图；This change could generate...给出预期效果。中间需要能产生该效果的具体协作措施，而非笼统主题描述。
exp.other: conservation 保护、文物修复；grant 资助；jointly 联合地；exhibition 展览。
exp.meaning: 要核实桥接是否构成‘政策→机制→结果’链条，不能因选项也谈博物馆或部门就草率接受。
exp.rest: 游客增加和以往报告差异只是主题信息；再把资金硬分成两部分反而违背联合申请改革。
